# Installing the File Integrity Operator {#installing-file-integrity-operator}

Install the File Integrity Operator on your cluster by using the OpenShift Container Platform web console or the {{ oc_first }}.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> All cluster nodes must have the same release version in order for this Operator to function properly. As an example, for nodes running {{ op_system }}, all nodes must have the same {{ op_system }} version.
